facts.title: injury during cleaning and preparation on K-7301

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control GAS_TEST_BEFORE_AND_DURING_HOT_WORK: the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.
Control HOT_WORK_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of hot work adjacent to live plant was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch on K-7301, M-7301 and TT-7301 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on K-7301, M-7301 and TT-7301 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining hazardous-area electrical equipment, specifically controlling portable electrical equipment in zoned areas. K-7301 (vapour recovery compressor) is in service for loading vapour recovery. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 3 March 2019 an incident occurred on K-7301, M-7301 and TT-7301 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during cleaning and preparation, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
